explication: feishu-cli is a Feishu Open Platform command-line tool, primarily used by AI agents. Its core user workflow converts local Markdown into Feishu documents (and exports documents back), while its many domain commands also manage collaboration data and services. The graph preserves documented product areas and separates command handling, shared API/auth infrastructure, and supporting runtime capabilities. Some subsystem links rely on README descriptions because their command implementations were not sampled.
